nm ROIC CHECK prefetch/forensic.json roic is 'unavailable' (needs per-year equity, debt, cash). Inputs from AV balance sheet 2026-06-30: equity 9,774m; cash 2,030m plus short-term investments 7,379m (treasuries, investments not operating cash); no financial debt, lease obligations 211m; so invested capital net of all cash and investments is about 9,774 + 211 - 9,409 = 576m against TTM operating income of about 2,987m (Q3'25 393 + Q4'25 575 + Q1'26 754 + Q2'26 912): ROIC is not meaningful on this base (very large). Treat as an asset-light, net-cash software business, ROIC should not drive the valuation; incremental ROIC uncomputed (gap).

nm OWN MULTIPLE HISTORY (GAAP diluted EPS, price = December month-end): trailing P/E low 190.8 (Dec-2023, EPS 0.09, price 17.17) median 282.1 (Dec-2025) high 398.1 (Dec-2024, EPS 0.19, price 75.63); Dec-2025 close 177.75 on EPS 0.63 = 282.1; now 184.56 on TTM GAAP EPS about 1.17 (net income attributable 3,016.7m Q3'25-Q2'26 / 2,568.7m diluted shares of Q2) = about 157; earlier years had losses (FY2022 EPS -0.18) so no P/E. Years 2023-2026. Forward P/E on attributed consensus EPS (AV, basis not stated, looks adjusted): FY2026 1.6149 -> 114.3, FY2027 2.3445 -> 78.7; there is no forward history, so forward low/median/high are a gap. The multiple has compressed every year as earnings caught up with price; the stock is expensive on every year of its own history. sources pf_eps_diluted_fy2023..fy2025, nm_ib_price, nm_av_consensus. A record quarter x 4 is peak earnings (Q2'26 EPS 0.41 x 4 = 1.64) and is not used as a run rate; growth is 93% y/y, so a run rate is a warning row only.

nm CONSENSUS (AV EARNINGS_ESTIMATES, attributed expectation, retrieved 2026-11-01): FY2026 revenue 8.215bn (n=30, 8.150-8.559bn) vs management guide 8.150-8.158bn raised 2026-08-03, i.e. consensus sits at or above the top of the guide; FY2027 revenue 12.36bn (n=29, 11.0-14.62bn, +50% y/y), widest dispersion; FY2026 EPS 1.61 (n=29, 1.51-1.74), FY2027 EPS 2.34 (n=30, 1.92-2.84); Q3 2026 revenue 2.181bn (n=24, 2.161-2.263bn) vs guide 2.160-2.164bn. Revisions: FY2026 EPS mean 1.4689 (90 d ago) -> 1.6116 (30 d) -> 1.6149; FY2027 EPS 2.0945 -> 2.3267 -> 2.3445: up about 10-12% over 90 days, flat over the last 30 days (Q3/Q4 2026 EPS means slipped slightly in the last 7-30 days, 2 downward revisions). Q3 2026 results are due about 2026-11-02/03 and are not citable (within 2 days of as_of); consensus for it is shown as an expectation only. No FY2028+ rows. No price targets collected.

nm TRACK RECORD revenue guided mid vs actual (USD m, quarterly guide issued with the prior quarter's release): Q4'24 769 vs 827.5 (+7.6%), Q1'25 860 vs 883.9 (+2.8%), Q2'25 936 vs 1003.7 (+7.2%), Q3'25 1085 vs 1181.1 (+8.9%), Q4'25 1329 vs 1406.8 (+5.9%), Q1'26 1534 vs 1632.6 (+6.4%), Q2'26 1799 vs 1935.5 (+7.6%), and the initial FY2025 guide 3749 (3741-3757) vs 4475.4 (+19.4%). 8 of 8 beats, 0 misses (see ticker-check for the ratio); the company beats its own guidance conservatively every quarter, mostly by 3-9%, and raises full-year guidance at every release (FY2025 3.75 -> 3.90 -> 4.15 -> 4.40bn; FY2026 7.19 -> 7.66 -> 8.15bn). Guidance is deliberately low, so the guided midpoint is a floor, not a forecast; the beat margin has been stable but acceleration is large (y/y growth 39% -> 48% -> 63% -> 70% -> 85% -> 93%). Releases pf_rel_*. FY2024 initial guide not in the saved releases (earliest saved 2024-11-04), a gap.

nm ADJUSTED FCF (company-defined, from releases; a non-GAAP measure, not used as a fact here): FY2025 2.270bn (51% margin); guidance for FY2026 raised from 3.925-4.125bn (Feb) to 4.2-4.4bn (May) to 4.5-4.7bn (Aug). GAAP CFO less capex FY2025 = 2,134m - 34m = 2,101m.

nm BALANCE SHEET 2026-06-30 (AV, equals 10-Q): cash 2.030bn, short-term investments 7.379bn (total 9.41bn), no financial debt, lease obligations 211m, equity 9.77bn; shares outstanding about 2.570bn (AV). Cash and investments excluded from operating capital in ROIC; no restricted cash identified from AV (restricted cash in the 10-Q not checked, a gap).
